# Architecture decisions

Why the system is built the way it is. One file per decision, append-only.

Write one when a decision is **hard to reverse, affects multiple capabilities,
or has real alternatives someone could question later**. Routine choices do
not get one — decision inflation makes ADRs stop being read.

An accepted ADR is never edited except to change its `status`. A reversal is a
new ADR that supersedes the old one.

Use the `new-adr` skill, or `framework/templates/adr.md` by hand.
